PEM
       Namespace PEM

DESCRIPTION
       The PEM Namespace deals with commands and events for the PEM (Policy Enforcement Manager ) module.

       Associated Events
	   * PEM_POLICY - an event which gets triggerd upon PEM policy attach and update to a flow
